title: 1,155 WBTC lost to address poisoning (Ethereum, 3 May 2024)
summary: A wallet paid its usual counterparty, an attacker planted a vanity lookalike (same first 4 and last 6 hex characters) in the wallet's history minutes later, and the wallet then sent 1,155 WBTC to the lookalike. Publicly reported on 3 May 2024; the funds were later reported returned.

public_sources.title: Analysis of the 1155 WBTC address-poisoning incident
public_sources.used_for: Victim, intended-recipient and lookalike addresses; first-4/last-6 character match; loss on 3 May; zero-value follow-up about 3 minutes after the user's transfer.

public_sources.title: Costly Mistake: Victim Loses $68 Million In Address Poisoning Scam
public_sources.used_for: Corroborates the 0xd9A1...853a91 prefix/suffix match and the ~$68M loss (via search summary).

public_sources.title: $68 million stolen in dust attack returned to victim
public_sources.used_for: Later return of the funds (context only; irrelevant to detection) (via search summary).

harm.description: The victim signed a transfer of 1155.28802767 WBTC (8 decimals) to the lookalike.

evaluation.rationale: The 21,600 blocks (about 3 days) up to and including the harmful block: a round default, not tuned to the result. It was set after the harmful WBTC transfer had been located, but before the other activity in the window (the native-ETH payment and the planted transfer) was examined.

onchain_verification: Verified on 2026-10-24 via eth.drpc.org: a WBTC Transfer log of 115528802767 base units from the victim to 0xd9A1C3788D81257612E2581A6ea0aDa244853a91 in tx 0x3374abc5...f570, block 19789009, signed by the victim.
Verified: the victim's nonce was 3 at block 19767409 and 5 at block 19789009, so it signed exactly two transactions in the window.
Verified: block 19788628, tx 0xb18ab131...83ac, the victim sent 0.05 ETH (native) to the intended recipient 0xd9A1b0B1e1aE382DbDc898Ea68012FfcB2853a91.

Verified: block 19788642, tx 0x9147d74e...957c, a Transfer of 50000 units of token 0x739352337C902c3874B95f14e81ebBCF1B7b262E 'from' the victim to the lookalike, in a transaction signed by 0x517DC8E50b8bf03A1D69c84d27bF96dC5A911Db2 (not the victim).
Verified: eth_getCode(victim) was empty at block 19789009 (plain EOA).
ground_truth_limitations: Attribution of the lookalike as the attacker's address comes from public reporting plus on-chain similarity; there is no court or exchange-confirmed attribution in the sources.

Public sources describe the planted transfer as 'zero-value'; on-chain it is a Transfer of 50000 units of token 0x739352337C902c3874B95f14e81ebBCF1B7b262E 'from' the victim in a transaction the victim did not sign. The nature of that token contract was not independently verified. The replay uses the on-chain data.
Only one wallet and one incident: this case cannot estimate detection rates or false-positive rates in general.
